## Business change

Describe the problem, affected IDs and intended meanings.

## Scope and evidence

State domain/context, sources, unresolved questions and compatibility implications.

## Review

- [ ] IDs and local references checked
- [ ] No unintended concept duplication or alias equivalence
- [ ] No invented source mapping or confidential examples
- [ ] Phase boundary respected
- [ ] Required business reviewers and approval status identified

A checked list does not by itself approve business meanings.
